subject: Guest webinar — request for attendee trial bundles and fulfillment steps
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo bundles for Aug 19 guest webinar

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for agreeing to have Redwood as our guest at the Aug 19 "Scaling Agents" webinar. We had a quick ops ask: can we provide 150 attendee trial bundles (promo codes) that grant a 30-day trial with 100K token credit each? The event audience skews startups and data-platform teams; giving slightly larger bundles helps with hands-on demos.

We can do a CSV with name + email if you need identity-based codes, otherwise anonymous codes work too. What is the best way to request the codes and who should be CC'd for fulfillment?

Attachments: promo_list_template.csv (sample CSV we can populate)

Thanks —
Emma Torres
Partnerships Manager, OpenAxis Events
emma@openaxis.co

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co> wrote:
> Quick follow up: we expect ~450 registrants, 220 attendees. 150 targeted promo bundles should cover us.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Promo bundles for Aug 19 guest webinar

Hi Lauren / Marcus —

OpenAxis is asking for 150 trial bundles (30 days, 100K tokens). They're fine with anonymous codes or a CSV of names/emails. Two quick questions before I confirm:

1) Is 100K tokens x 150 within promo budget for Events in Q3?
2) If we do identity-based codes, what limits / flags do we need to add on the account side (rate limits, attribution tags)?

Emma — we'll coordinate internally and come back with fulfillment steps and a delivery ETA. If anonymous codes are easier on our side, we're happy to provide those.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co> wrote:
> Attaching the CSV template. Let me know if you need modifications.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Promo bundles for Aug 19 guest webinar

Karthik / Marcus —

I ran the numbers with Marketing; Q3 event promo pool can cover 150 bundles at 100K tokens but that uses ~55% of the webinar/event bucket for the month. Two asks if we move forward:

- Add an attribution tag in the promo metadata: "openaxis_aug19" so Marketing can track conversions.
- Set a per-account rate cap of 10 requests/min and disable auto-billing on promo accounts (trial-only) to avoid accidental charges.

Operationally we can provide anonymous codes as a bulk CSV (preferred) and we can also accept a name/email list if the partner insists — but identity-based issuance will need manual reconcile.

Marcus — could you confirm the mechanism for creating the codes & delivery? If we can generate the anonymous CSV, we should deliver by EOD Aug 7 to give partners time to prep their reminders.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Growth Ops, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 08:27 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marketing prefers anonymous codes for volume tracking but will accept named codes if that improves conversion.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Torres <emma@openaxis.co>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Promo bundles for Aug 19 guest webinar

All —

We can create 150 anonymous promo codes (30 days / 100,000 tokens) and deliver a CSV. Delivery timeline: generate codes and validate quota tags by COB Aug 7, deliver CSV via secure SharePoint link. Implementation details:

- Promo meta: attribution=openaxis_aug19, campaign=guest_webinar
- Trial config: expiration=30d from redemption, token_allowance=100000, auto-billing=false
- Rate limits: 10 req/min per account (applied at account creation)

Emma — we'll share a secure link to the CSV once it's ready. Please confirm whether you want anonymous codes or if you will supply a filled CSV of name+email (note: named issuance requires a manual reconcile and 24hr extra lead time).

Approved by Lauren to proceed; Marcus will handle generation.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
